suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment associated risk. Require HIV/AIDS, antiretroviral immune recovery, and separately diagnosed immune-recovery uveitis; document relevant ocular history such as CMV retinitis when present. Treatment/immune-reconstitution phenotype; do not generalize to all uveitis in HIV. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation of the qualifying treatment or procedure used for HIV / AIDS
Independent diagnosis of Uveitis and timing relative to that exposure
Dose, duration, procedure details, and relevant co-exposures where applicable
Qualified clinical assessment of competing causes and source-phenotype fit
